//: [fix3-stop] STOP button compliance (EN 50636-2-107:2015/A3:2021 20.101.4 = IEC 60335-2-107:2017+A1:2020; marking 7.9). The flush 18 mm pad (0 mm raised, orange, icon only) is replaced by a raised, parallel-guided d 40 red STOP key with a white STOP legend on the flush lid; see stopkit.py.

lid.//stop_pad: the f2 flush pad, its halo paint and its plunger are gone (stop_pad null switches them off)

stop_key.//: geometry in m, forces in N / (N/mm), tolerances in mm; every key not listed takes stopkit.DEFAULTS
stop_key.//x: null = centre of the real STOP key's top (bbox) = x 4.4 mm; y 0
stop_key.//r: cap d 40: geometric minor dimension 40 >= 35 (5 mm margin)
stop_key.//stroke: cap travel to its own stop (parallel guide: the same at every point of the cap) - covers tip gap worst case 3.16 + key switch travel <= 1.5
stop_key.//clear: skirt clearance to the lid at full stroke -> cap floats 5.5 over the lid
stop_key.//gap: tip to scanned key, closed lid: worst case -0.16 (key pre-pressed 0.16 < 0.3 switch travel) .. 3.16
stop_key.//arm: parallel links 70 long, 5.5 apart, stainless U-channels 12.2 x 2.8 x 0.8 (Euler 2450 N vs 223 N at the 1 J impact): the cap translates, never tilts (no drawer jam, no edge-force factor)
stop_key.//legend_w: STOP inlay 28 x 7.4 mm (Liberation Sans Bold), white 2K, reads from in front of the mower (the rear-hinged lid is operated from the front / side)
stop_key.//key: ASSUMED range of the real STOP key (fixed hardware, scanned): switch travel 0.3..1.5, full travel >= 0.8, switch force 3..15 N - supplier to confirm

lid.//spring_N: [fix3-int] removed (was 5.2): the f2 constant-force band is superseded by fix-hinge's tape + spiral-spring drum (lid.h3). The STOP parts' mass now enters the lid balance from their meshes (stopkit.mass_mesh -> lidmech extra_mass) and the h3 spiral spring is retuned for the total lid in fix3_hinge.json

colors.//stop: STOP red (ISO 3864-4 safety red / RAL 3020 range) for the lid key, the real key and its stand-in; the old orange accent is not used anywhere any more
